headline: Adams State score at last and win at Wayland Baptist
dek: Adams State's goal at Wayland Baptist on Saturday was their first of the season, and it won them their first match. The three defeats before it had all come without a goal, and seven have gone in at the other end.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The gap between the top and the bottom of the chart is still wide: Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State have scored fewer goals together than UCCS have alone.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo have won all four of their matches and conceded one goal, and are the only side yet to drop a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but nine have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis's draw with Western Washington leaves them with two wins, two draws and one defeat, and they have conceded three goals all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's win over Hawaii Hilo is their fourth in four matches, and they have scored eight goals while conceding one.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have lost five and drawn one after the defeat to Dallas Baptist, and are the only side still without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zach Jennings has made nineteen saves for Regis and been beaten three times.

last_match.line: Regis have still lost only at Cal State LA; Western Washington had lost at Westminster on Thursday.

next_match.line: MSU Denver have not lost since their opening match; Hawaii Hilo have already lost at UCCS and at CSU Pueblo this month.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
